body:
## Pull request overview

Modularizes the kernel event-bus protocol into smaller Zod sub-modules and adds/updates documentation to support the planned v3.0 migration narrative.

**Changes:**
- Split `kernel/events.zod.ts` into multiple focused modules under `kernel/events/` and kept `events.zod.ts` as a backward-compatible re-export barrel.
- Added `packages/spec/V3_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md` describing breaking changes and migration steps for v3.0.
- Updated roadmap/report/changelog docs to mark milestones complete and reflect updated test counts.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/core.zod.ts | New core event schemas (priority, metadata, base event, type definition). |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/handlers.zod.ts | New handler/route/persistence schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/queue.zod.ts | New queue/replay/sourcing configuration schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/dlq.zod.ts | New DLQ + event log entry schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/integrations.zod.ts | New webhook/message-queue/realtime integration schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/bus.zod.ts | New top-level event bus config schema (+ helper functions). |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events/index.ts | New barrel file for event sub-modules. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/events.zod.ts | Replaced monolith with re-exports from the new sub-modules. |
| packages/spec/V3_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md | New migration guide for v3.0 changes and mappings. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated phase checklist and metrics (test file/test count, modularization progress). |
| PROTOCOL_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md | Marked Sprint K (events modularization) and overall sprint completion as done. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Added unreleased notes for events modularization + migration guide. |
</details>

The doc comment claims new code should import directly from `./events/` sub-modules for better tree-shaking, but `@objectstack/spec` currently only exports the `./kernel` subpath and the build bundles `kernel/index` (no separate `kernel/events/*` entrypoints). This makes the suggested consumer import style misleading unless package exports/build are updated. Consider either (a) exposing `./kernel/events/*` as real entrypoints via `package.json` `exports` + tsup `entry`, or (b) adjusting the comment to clarify these sub-modules are an internal source-code organization detail and should still be imported via `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.
```suggestion
 * This file re-exports all event schemas from modular sub-modules for backward compatibility
 * and to provide a single stable entrypoint for consumers (via `@objectstack/spec/kernel`).
 * 
 * NOTE: The `./events/*` sub-modules referenced below are an internal source-code organization
 * detail of the kernel. External code should continue to import event schemas from the
 * published kernel entrypoint, for example:
 * 
 *   import { EventBusSchema } from '@objectstack/spec/kernel';
 * 
 * and SHOULD NOT import from `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events/*` unless those paths are
 * explicitly documented as public entrypoints in the package exports.
 * 
```

The tables are written with a leading double pipe (`||`), which renders as an extra empty column (or fails to render cleanly) in standard GitHub-flavored Markdown. Update these to use standard pipe table syntax (`| ... |`) so the guide renders correctly.

These examples recommend importing from `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events/*`, but the package does not currently export `./kernel/events/*` subpaths and the build outputs a bundled `kernel/index` entry. As written, these imports will not resolve for consumers unless you add explicit `exports` entries and build entrypoints for each `kernel/events/*` module. Update the examples or expose these subpaths.

This `kernel/events/index.ts` barrel is not referenced by `kernel/events.zod.ts` or any current entrypoint, and `@objectstack/spec` does not export a `./kernel/events` subpath. As a result it is likely unused and won’t be emitted in `dist`, which can confuse maintainers. Consider removing it, or wiring it up as an actual public entrypoint (tsup `entry` + `package.json` `exports`) if you want `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events` imports to work.
```suggestion
 * Event Bus Protocol - Kernel Events
 *
 * NOTE:
 * - Canonical Zod schemas live in the sibling `*.zod.ts` files
 *   (e.g. `core.zod.ts`, `handlers.zod.ts`, `queue.zod.ts`, `dlq.zod.ts`,
 *   `integrations.zod.ts`, `bus.zod.ts`).
 * - Public entrypoints MUST be wired via `tsup` `entry` and `package.json`
 *   `exports` (for example through `kernel/events.zod.ts`), not by relying
 *   on this file as a barrel.
 *
 * This file intentionally exports nothing to avoid defining an implicit
 * `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events` subpath that is not part of the
 * published API surface.
 */
```

This file introduces new runtime helper functions (`createEventBusConfig`, `createEventTypeDefinition`, `createEventWebhookConfig`). Given the ongoing direction to keep `@objectstack/spec` declarative and move runtime helpers to `@objectstack/core` (as documented in the migration guide), these helpers should either be avoided here or explicitly marked `@deprecated` with a clear removal plan/location (or moved to core now) to prevent expanding the runtime surface area of the spec package.
Updated in 45ee05c. The doc comment now clarifies that `./events/*` sub-modules are an internal source-code organization detail and consumers should import from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`.
Checked the table syntax — the tables in the guide use standard `| ... |` pipe syntax and render correctly in GitHub-flavored Markdown. No leading double-pipe issues found.
Fixed in 45ee05c. Updated import examples to use top-level subpaths (`@objectstack/spec/api` and `@objectstack/spec/shared`) which match the published `exports` in `package.json`.

Fixed in 45ee05c. Rewrote the events section to clarify the restructuring is internal — no migration needed, consumers continue importing from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`. Removed all `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events/*` examples.

Fixed in 45ee05c. Replaced the barrel re-exports with a doc-only comment explaining this file is not part of the published API surface and `@objectstack/spec/kernel/events` is not an exported subpath.

Fixed in 45ee05c. All three helper functions (`createEventBusConfig`, `createEventTypeDefinition`, `createEventWebhookConfig`) are now marked `@deprecated` with direction to move to `@objectstack/core` and removal in v3.0.0.
